infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Fresh Greens reads your upcoming events to offer them as safe-routed destinations. It never edits your calendar.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Fresh Greens uses your location to suggest routes that maximize visibility, daylight, and familiarity.

plugins.microphonePermission: Fresh Greens records audio during traffic stops as ambient protection. Recordings are saved to your account and never shared without your action.

plugins.contactsPermission: Fresh Greens lets you pick a trusted contact to be alerted during safety events. We only read the contact you select.

plugins.calendarPermission: Fresh Greens reads your upcoming events to offer them as safe-routed destinations. It never edits your calendar.
